categories.name: Game systems
categories.description: Rules, sheets and content for a specific tabletop game system

categories.name: Compatibility layers
categories.description: Bridges that bring content or sheets from other platforms

categories.name: Themes
categories.description: Visual themes for a game: stylesheets, textures and fonts

categories.name: Tools
categories.description: Table tools: notes and lore from other apps, polls and other helpers

repository.name: Roll20 Compatibility Layer
repository.description: Ports community Roll20 character sheets (Blades in the Dark, Fate Core, ...) as NordvikManager addon cards
repository.author: haffff

repository.name: 40K Imperium Maledictum Theme
repository.description: Dark imperial frame and parchment panels to go with the Imperium Maledictum character sheet. Switches itself on when installed (Game Settings > Appearance).
repository.author: haffff

repository.name: Trilium
repository.description: Search your Trilium notes from the game, pin them to tokens and share lore with players when the story gets there. Needs TriliumNext with an ETAPI token; a Trilium on your computer or network must be allowed in Application Settings > Server > Local network access.
repository.author: haffff

repository.name: Obsidian
repository.description: Search your Obsidian vault from the game, pin notes to tokens and share lore with players when the story gets there. Needs Obsidian open with the Local REST API plugin (its HTTP server on); the server's admin allows it in Application Settings > Server > Local network access.
repository.author: haffff

repository.name: Poll
repository.description: Let the table vote: a poll window pops up for everyone, or vote with /vote in chat. Secret ballots, results hidden until the poll closes, multiple choice and changing your vote are switches per poll. The GM decides whether players can start polls too.
repository.author: haffff
